**About Us**

For nearly 60 years, 1928 Jewelry has been a beloved heritage brand, offering timeless jewelry and accessories inspired by vintage design. Our collections are available on our Shopify website, Amazon, and through leading retail partners. We are expanding our online e\-commerce presence and are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented E\-Commerce \& Digital Marketing Specialist to join our in\-house Marketing team. This is a full\-time, on\-site position ideal for someone eager to grow their skills in e\-commerce, paid advertising and social media marketing.

**What You'll Do**

This role is responsible for the day\-to\-day execution across paid advertising, email marketing, website, and multiple marketplace channels. It's a hands\-on position for someone who's comfortable moving between ad dashboards, spreadsheets, product listings, and customer inquiries in a single day.

* Develop, implement, and monitor paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta, and Amazon to maximize reach and ROI.
* Build and deploy email marketing campaigns and flows in Klaviyo.
* Manage and optimize the 1928\.com website using the Shopify platform ensuring seamless user experiences and high performance. Optimize product titles, meta descriptions, image alt tags, and page URLs.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to improve organic search rankings, boost visibility, and increase web traffic.
* Write and maintain product descriptions, pricing and assist with management of online inventory across multiple e\-commerce platforms including Amazon, Walmart, Faire, Etsy, Shein, etc.
* Handle website customer service inquiries with professionalism and care
* Support social media campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging channels.
* Track and report on channel performance using Shopify and Google Analytics; identify opportunities for growth.
* Coordinate with external developers including Microsoft Dynamics NAV for website data integrations.
* Collaboratively work as part of the e\-commerce marketing team focusing on the 1928 website user experience including updating product descriptions, website feature additions and general maintenance.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge and demonstrated experience of paid marketing advertising campaigns including Google Ads, SEM strategies, and paid advertising campaign management.
* Expertise with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics for performance reporting and insights generation.
* Ability to analyze data trends using marketing analytics tools to optimize campaigns effectively. Proficiency with SEO tools.
* Experience with content creation across multiple channels including websites, blogs, email newsletters, and social media platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and TikTok Shop.
* Expert\-level Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis).
* Strong written communication and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple channels and deadlines simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in social media advertising (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads), including experience sourcing, negotiating, and managing both paid and gifted/unpaid influencer and creator collaborations — from outreach and contracting through content approval and performance tracking.
* Working knowledge of website SEO best practices, with familiarity in ADA and WCAG accessibility standards — including hands\-on experience auditing and optimizing site content (alt text, heading structure, link text, and metadata) to be both search\-optimized and accessibility\-compliant.
* Experience with Klaviyo or comparable email platforms.
* Genuine interest in fashion jewelry, accessories, or the broader fashion industry.

**Why Join Us**

You'll have real ownership over channels that directly drive revenue, working on a small, collaborative team where your work is visible and your ideas get heard.

**What We Offer**

* Full\-time, on\-site position
* Creative and collaborative work environment
* Employee discounts on jewelry
* Paid time off
* Health, Vision, Dental and Life and Long Time Disability Insurance
* 401(k)

**Schedule \& Location**

* 4 day workweek \- Monday through Thursday, 10\-hour shifts
* In\-person at our Burbank, CA headquarters (Remote work opportunities not available)

**Job Type:** Full\-time

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

* 401(k)

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

The Senior Manager, Marketing Events leads the strategy, prioritization, and execution of the firm’s U.S. events portfolio as a core component of business development and client engagement. This role is responsible for ensuring that events are aligned to firm, practice, and industry priorities; deliver measurable impact; and are executed with operational excellence.


This individual serves as a strategic partner to firm leadership, partners, business development strategists, and other stakeholders. They are responsible for guiding event strategy from concept through post\-event follow\-up and ROI analysis. The role also leads the continued evolution of the U.S. events model, including intake, go/no\-go decisioning, and performance measurement.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

*These essential functions are primary job duties that incumbents must be able to perform unassisted or with some reasonable accommodation.*

Event Strategy \& Portfolio Management:


* Lead the development and execution of an events portfolio aligned to strategic growth areas, client priorities, and practice/industry objectives.
* Partner with practice, industry, and BD leaders to shape event strategies that drive client engagement and pipeline development.
* Establish and enforce a disciplined go/no\-go framework, ensuring resources are focused on high\-impact opportunities.

Business Development Integration \& ROI:


* Partner with Business Development and Marketing Strategists to ensure events are fully integrated into broader campaigns and account strategies.
* Define and track success metrics across the event lifecycle, including attendance quality, engagement, and business outcomes.
* Translate event data into actionable insights and recommendations, informing future investment decisions and portfolio optimization.

Operational Excellence \& Process Leadership:


* Lead the continued evolution of the firm’s centralized event management model, including intake, planning workflows, and execution standards.
* Oversee event management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Cvent), ensuring data integrity, reporting consistency, and process adoption
* Drive continuous improvement of event processes, tools, and vendor strategies to enhance efficiency, scalability, and user experience.

Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management:


* Manage and develop a team of event professionals, setting clear expectations, standards, and priorities.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to partners and senior stakeholders, providing guidance on event strategy, positioning, and execution.
* Foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Marketing, Business Development, and firm leadership.

Vendor \& Financial Management:


* Oversee vendor selection, contract negotiation, and performance management to ensure quality, value, and risk mitigation.
* Manage event budgets with a focus on ROI, cost discipline, and strategic investment.

Execution Oversight:


* Ensure seamless execution of high\-profile, client\-facing events, including in\-person, hybrid, and virtual formats.
* Provide or oversee onsite support as required.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Deep expertise in event strategy, planning, and execution within a professional services environment.
* Demonstrated ability to connect events to business development outcomes and measurable ROI.
* Strong analytical capabilities, with experience leveraging Salesforce and event platforms to drive insights.
* Proven leadership experience, including team development and stakeholder influence at senior levels.
* Exceptional project management and prioritization skills in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management and vendor negotiation.
* Excellent communication and executive presence.

**EDUCATION, LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, AND EXPERIENCE**

* 10\+ years of experience in event strategy and management, with increasing leadership responsibility.

**Assistant Community Manager**


**Location:** On\-site \|Harlem


**Reports to:** Community Manager


**Salary:** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 plus discretionary bonus


**About Twin Pines Management**
-------------------------------



Twin Pines is a fast\-growing, full\-service property management firm redefining multifamily living across New York City from market\-rate communities to large\-scale affordable housing portfolios. We operate some of the city's most complex and impactful assets, that have helped shape neighborhoods.Our team works at the intersection of performance, compliance, hospitality, and resident experience. We partner with sophisticated owners and institutions, giving our professionals exposure to high\-level strategy while staying close to the day\-to\-day operations that drive real results.



We leverage cutting\-edge technology, data analytics, and best practices, offering our team the tools, structure, and career pathways of a national platform while maintaining the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a New York–focused firm. At Twin Pines, you won't just manage properties, you'll solve complex challenges and grow alongside a leadership team that values accountability, innovation, and opportunity.


**Role and Responsibilities Overview**
--------------------------------------



The Assistant Community Manager plays a key role in supporting the daily operations, resident experience, and financial health of an Affordable, Project\-based Section 8, and LIHTC community. This position partners closely with the Community Manager to ensure leasing, resident communication, rent collections, and administrative processes run smoothly and consistently.



You'll be a visible, trusted presence for residents and an operational anchor for the on\-site team—helping keep the property organized, responsive, and market\-ready. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and looking to grow into a long\-term career in multifamily property management.



Success in this role means residents feel supported, files are audit\-ready, leasing goals stay on track, and the Community Manager can rely on you as a true operational partner.


**Resident Experience \& Leasing Support**


* Serve as a primary point of contact for residents and prospects, providing professional, friendly, and timely service
* Assist with leasing activities including tours, applications, move\-ins, renewals, and resident communications
* Support resident issue resolution through clear documentation, follow\-up, and coordination with maintenance and management
* Maintain a positive, welcoming office and community environment


**Administrative \& Financial Support**


* Prepare, process, and maintain resident files in accordance with company standards
* Assist with rent collections, posting payments, and delinquency follow\-up
* Support reporting, invoicing, and basic financial tracking as directed by the Community Manager
* Ensure accuracy of data in property management systems


**Operations \& Team Collaboration**


* Partner with maintenance and leasing teams to support unit readiness and occupancy goals
* Assist with scheduling, vendor coordination, and service request tracking
* Ensure policies, procedures, and fair housing practices are consistently followed
* Step in to support day\-to\-day operations as needed, including coverage during absences

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Strong customer service and communication skills
* High attention to detail and comfort with administrative work
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment
* Collaborative, team\-oriented mindset
* Comfort learning and using property management systems and office tools
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling resident information
* Bilingual in Spanish and/or Chinese (Mandarin) preferred; English required


**Education \& Experience**


* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Prior experience in Affordable, Project\-based Section 8, or LIHTC multifamily housing required; leasing, hospitality, or customer\-facing experience is a plus
* Familiarity with property management software (e.g., Yardi) is a plus


**Work Environment \& Physical Requirements**


* On\-site office and residential community environment
* Regular walking of the property and interaction with residents
* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 pounds occasionally
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods


*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.*


**Perks \& Benefits**
---------------------



We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and work\-life balance.


**Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage** Access to multiple medical plan options through our benefits partner, including PPO and HMO plans, allowing employees to choose coverage that best fits their needs.


**Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)** Pre\-tax accounts available for eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses.


**401(k) Retirement Plan** Opportunity to contribute to a tax\-advantaged retirement plan to support long\-term financial planning.


**Paid Time Off \& Holidays** Competitive PTO program, including paid holidays, vacation, and sick time.


**Commuter Benefits** Pre\-tax commuter benefits available for transit and parking expenses.


**Professional Growth \& Development** Exposure to complex, high\-impact work within affordable housing, with opportunities to grow leadership skills and deepen regulatory and operational expertise.


**Mission\-Driven Work** The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting affordable housing communities across New York City.


*Benefits offerings and employee contributions may vary by plan and are subject to change.*

You will support the team's budgeting and forecasting efforts and will dive deep to help the Company level up its understanding of what drives key financial metrics. **Your Priorities**


* Assist with monthly financial statement variance analyses comparing actual results to budgets, forecasts, and historical trends
* Contribute to the Company's rolling forecasts, annual operating plan, and long\-range projections
* Analyze and report on key SaaS metrics (ARR, churn, retention) to support monthly forecasting and reporting
* Calculate incentive compensation (commissions, sales bonuses) on a monthly basis and provide insights into how to streamline the process
* Execute key month\- and quarter\-end close activities, preparing accurate reporting deliverables for both internal and external stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement processes and tools to control data integrity and alignment between systems
* Identify and execute process improvements, including ways to leverage AI to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency
* Support other ad hoc finance items and special projects


**Your Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree in quantitative field – accounting or finance preferred
* 1\-3 years of combined experience in financial analysis or accounting
* High proficiency with Microsoft Excel
* Understanding of GAAP and financial statements
* Very high attention to detail and ownership over your work
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain financial data to non\-finance partners
* Ability to draw upon insights and tell a compelling story involving business metrics
* A curiosity to learn and take initiative to tackle problems independently
* Strong critical thinking, organizational, interpersonal, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Demonstrate our core values: Humility, Innovation, and a Drive for Excellence


**It's a plus if you have:**


* Professional finance designation – CPA or MBA is preferred
* Experience working in SaaS and/or startup environment; understanding of ARR and SaaS unit economics
* Experience with Salesforce, Netsuite, Aleph, and/or related softwares is preferred
* Experience using AI to automate workflows (Claude Cowork or other)
* Proficiency in financial modeling and sensitivity analysis
* Comfort working in a constantly changing environment; able to deal with ambiguity


**Compensation**



The total compensation for this role (base salary \+ bonuses) will be between $75,000 \- $100,000k/yr depending upon experience.

Subsplash currently has operations in 27 states across the US! AL, AR, AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IA, IN, KS, KY, MO, MI, MN, NC, NM, OK, OH, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WY.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The SOX Manager is responsible for internal control assessment, including working with Business Lines to assess the effectiveness of the bank’s control environment. Responsibilities include ensuring that processes and controls identified to mitigate financial reporting risks are properly designed and executed, including identification of gaps and solutions to minimize financial reporting errors resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human error. Completes annual SOX walkthroughs of business processes for the purpose of determining whether control design and performance meet control objectives and are consistent with expected standards. Facilitates the documentation of business processes, which includes the identification and evaluation of specific control activities. Consults with the business lines on process changes ensuring that control design updates are appropriate


Additional responsibilities include completion of third party vendor evaluations, deficiency evaluations, internal control documentation review \& updates, and business line consultative services with respect to internal controls, specifically addressing financial reporting, data management, and operational business processes.

This full time, on\-site position comes with a generous benefits and compensation package.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  The HR Generalist will play a crucial role in managing the full cycle of recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, HRIS system maintenance, and employee retention. This position requires a detail\-oriented and people\-focused professional who can develop and implement effective HR strategies to support our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in HR practices, excellent communication skills, and a passion for fostering a positive workplace culture.

* Manage the full recruitment process, including job postings, resume screening, interviewing, and selection.
* Collaborate with department heads to understand staffing needs and create job descriptions.

* Oversee the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition and positive experience.
* Conduct new hire orientations and ensure all necessary paperwork is completed.
* Coordinate with various departments to ensure new employees have the tools and resources they need to succeed.
* Develop and implement employee retention strategies to reduce turnover and increase job satisfaction.

* Assist in drafting and updating the company's policies, procedures and standards under a supervisor's oversight.
* Maintain excellent knowledge of the company's benefit programs and assist employees as needed in enrollment, communicate with vendors, resolve billing issues, and make recommendations for change to the Director of HR.
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all Human Resources issues and records.

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:**

* A minimum of a bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, or similar program required.
* 5 years of progressive Human Resources position, with a substantial portion of it in a manufacturing operation.

* Experience in providing value added HR coaching, guidance, thought leadership, and HR business partnership in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

* Must be able to read, write, and communicate fluently in English.

description:
**Join a Company That's Been Part of This Community for Generations**


Kinsley Enterprises isn't just another employer \- we're a longstanding, family\-owned business that has helped build the York, PA community from the ground up, literally. Across construction, heavy manufacturing, and metal fabrication, our operating companies have been trusted names in this region for decades. When you join Kinsley, you're joining a company where people know your name, where leadership is accessible, and where "family business" isn't a tagline \- it's how we operate every day.


We're looking for an **HR Generalist** to be a key part of our Human Resources team \- someone who's organized, people\-focused, and ready to grow their HR career with a company that genuinely invests in its people.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* **A Career, Not Just a Job \-** Kinsley is committed to developing our talent from within. You'll have access to real professional development opportunities, mentorship, and a clear path for growth as you build your HR expertise.
* **Local Roots, Real Impact \-** As a multi\-entity, family\-owned business rooted in this community, the work you do here has a visible, tangible impact on local employees and local operations.
* **A Team That Has Your Back \-** You'll work directly with our HR team and report to a Chief Human Resources Officer who is invested in your success, in an environment where no two days look the same.
* **Variety and Ownership \-** From recruitment to onboarding to employee relations, you'll get exposure across the full HR function \- perfect for someone who wants to build a well\-rounded, generalist skill set.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the day\-to\-day of HR operations \- from maintaining employee records and processing new hires to preparing offer letters and employment documentation.
* Deliver a great first impression by coordinating new hire orientation and onboarding.
* Support full\-cycle recruiting: posting roles, sourcing and screening candidates, scheduling interviews, and being a positive, professional point of contact for every candidate.
* Be a trusted resource for employees and managers, answering HR questions with professionalism and genuine care.
* Assist with benefits administration, leave programs, and compliance tracking.
* Contribute to special projects and, occasionally, provide on\-site HR support to one of our operating companies \- a great way to broaden your exposure across our business.

**What You Bring**

* 3\+ years of HR experience (5\+ preferred); a Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field preferred.
* A genuine service mindset \- you're the person who takes initiative and pitches in wherever needed.
* Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of employment law (FLSA, FMLA, ADA, and more).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; HRIS/ATS experience is a plus.
* PHR or SHRM\-CP certification is a plus \- and if you're working toward one, we'll support that goal.
* Experience with a multi\-entity or family\-owned business is a bonus, not a requirement

**Benefits**

* A robust major medical plan to include three plan options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) program
* 9 paid holidays
* Company provided (free) short\-term disability, Long\-term disability, and life insurance
* Continued education support

**Ready to grow your HR career with a company that's been a cornerstone of this community for generations? Apply today and become part of the Kinsley family.**

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator contributes to the overall success of the Talent Acquisition (TA) team by providing a high level of customer service, administrative support, and project coordination throughout the talent acquisition process. This role supports the full\-life cycle of talent acquisition and recruitment activities. The TA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the candidate interview process to ensure a smooth and positive experience with all potential employees; scheduling and monitoring pre\-employment background checks and drug testing; processing new\-hire onboarding documentation; and facilitating and processing of candidate travel arrangements and expenses.


This individual will be working from our Oshkosh Global Headquarters in Oshkosh, WI.

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Partners with the Talent Acquisition Partner(s) to execute on the talent acquisition lifecycle.
* Champions the candidate experience and ensures candidates are treated like customers as it relates to scheduling, providing feedback, answering questions, and providing status updates.
* Coordinate all aspects of the candidate interview process, including scheduling, resource and room reservation and video conference set up.
* Schedule, monitor and communicate pre\-employment background checks and drug testing results to Talent Acquisition Partner(s); escalate any discrepancies.
* Facilitate candidate travel arrangements for interviews and process candidate expenses related to travel.
* Establish and maintain working relationships with internal stakeholders, including team members and business partners, to assist with recruiting and hiring needs.
* Provide support for other TA processes, projects, and business initiatives, including candidate sourcing and screening and research, data collection, and utilizing information from Workday Recruiting for reporting.
* Support recruiting related events as needed, attending at times.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent with one (1\) or more years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or a related area.
* OR equivalent combination of education and experience

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience and proficiency with various web\-based software applications including Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization.
* Strong customer focus and organizational skills with exceptional follow through and attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively multi\-task and prioritize competing requirements and meet deadlines.

Gotion Inc. is based in Silicon Valley, CA, currently building a Manufacturing facility in Manteno, IL and has R\&D centers in Ohio, China, Japan and Europe. We innovate in the next generation electric vehicle and energy storage technologies (lithium batteries and related systems) with the aim to accelerate electrified transportation and achieve sustainable development. Gotion is powered by a leading power battery technology company that provides solutions for vehicles including the world's first mass commercial e\-bus route.  

  

Gotion is a career destination \- we are not simply attempting to just fill another job, but to pursue a dream of global green energy together! We offer outstanding opportunities to individuals seeking an exciting and challenging working environment. Everyone is highly valued and plays a vital role in the growth of our organization.

**Recruiting Manager (Bilingual Mandarin Required)**


**Location:** Manteno, IL  

**Department:** Human Resources – Talent Acquisition  

**Work Arrangement:** 100% On\-Site


**Position Summary**



Gotion is seeking an experienced **Recruiting Manager (Bilingual Mandarin)** to lead our Talent Acquisition function during an exciting period of rapid growth. This role is responsible for developing and executing recruiting strategies while leading a team of recruiters supporting manufacturing, engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and corporate functions.



The Recruiting Manager will serve as a strategic business partner to both U.S. and China\-based leadership, requiring the ability to communicate effectively in **English and Mandarin** to support hiring initiatives, workforce planning, and cross\-functional collaboration.

  


**What You'll Do**


**Talent Acquisition Leadership**


* Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters and recruiting coordinators to achieve hiring goals across multiple business functions.
* Establish recruiting priorities, hiring strategies, and performance expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement within the Talent Acquisition organization.


**Strategic Workforce Planning**


* Partner with U.S. and China\-based executives, HR leaders, and hiring managers to forecast workforce needs and develop strategic recruiting plans.
* Support organizational growth by aligning recruiting strategies with business objectives.


**Full\-Cycle Recruitment**


* Oversee full\-cycle recruiting for engineering, manufacturing, operations, finance, supply chain, IT, quality, and leadership positions.
* Personally recruit for executive, highly technical, and confidential positions when needed.


**Talent Sourcing \& Pipeline Development**


* Develop innovative sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, industry associations, universities, military recruiting, referrals, and passive candidate outreach.
* Build long\-term talent pipelines for critical and difficult\-to\-fill positions.


**Recruiting Operations**


* Optimize recruiting workflows, ATS processes (Greenhouse preferred), interview processes, and reporting.
* Ensure a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.


**Analytics \& Reporting**


* Monitor recruiting KPIs including:
* + Time\-to\-Fill
	+ Time\-to\-Hire
	+ Offer Acceptance Rate
	+ Cost\-per\-Hire
	+ Recruiter Productivity
	+ Diversity Metrics
* Present recruiting performance and hiring forecasts to executive leadership.


**Employer Branding**


* Partner with HR and Marketing to strengthen Gotion's employer brand.
* Represent Gotion at universities, career fairs, professional organizations, and industry events.


**Compliance**


* Ensure recruiting practices comply with federal, state, and local employment laws and company policies.
* Maintain consistent hiring documentation and process compliance.

  


**What You'll Bring**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin (speaking, reading, and writing) is required.**
* 7\+ years of progressive recruiting experience, including technical, manufacturing, engineering, and corporate recruiting.
* 3\+ years of recruiting leadership or Talent Acquisition management experience.
* Experience leading recruiting teams in a high\-growth manufacturing, automotive, battery, industrial, or technology environment.
* Proven experience partnering with international business leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of workforce planning, recruiting strategy, direct sourcing, employment branding, and talent market intelligence.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (Greenhouse preferred), HRIS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruitment analytics.
* Excellent communication, coaching, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering exceptional customer service to hiring managers and candidates.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working for a global or multinational organization.
* Experience supporting U.S. and Asia\-based business operations.
* Startup or greenfield manufacturing experience.
* SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, SPHR, AIRS, or LinkedIn Recruiter Certification.
* Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma experience.

**What Do You Need To Bring?**

* At least 18 years of age
* Working towards a Bachelor’s degree (Intern)

Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.

------------------

description:
At Quality Brand Group, our Dunkin’ and Baskin\-Robbins restaurants position us as a leader in the large\-scale, multi\-market QSR industry and the largest Dunkin’ franchisee in the West region. Our teams are fueled by more than just coffee—they are powered by passion, people, and performance. As we continue opening new Dunkin' locations and expanding our business, we are seeking a dynamic Regional Manager to help lead us to the next level.


We are looking for an experienced leader who can develop and inspire store teams, drive sales growth, and deliver exceptional guest experiences across multiple locations. If you are a results\-oriented leader who thrives on building high\-performing teams and fostering a culture where people love to work, we invite you to read on.

  

The **Regional Manager of Operations** is responsible for overseeing the operational performance of multiple restaurant locations within a specific region. The role involves ensuring that each restaurant under their leadership delivers exceptional guest experiences, achieves financial targets, maintains operational standards, and fosters team development. The Regional Manager of Operations reports to the Vice President of Operations and serves as the link between corporate strategy and the frontline execution at individual stores.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Oversee day\-to\-day operations across all restaurants within the region, ensuring that all locations maintain high operational standards.
* **Implement and enforce operational policies** in line with corporate guidelines to ensure compliance with health, safety, and food handling regulations.
* Regularly visit restaurant locations to **conduct performance evaluations**, identify areas for improvement, and provide strategic recommendations for operational enhancements.
* Ensure that all restaurants **meet or exceed key performance metrics** (e.g., speed of service, guest satisfaction, and order accuracy).
* Develop and execute strategies to **drive profitability** at the regional level by controlling costs, optimizing labor, and increasing sales.
* Monitor and analyze financial reports (P\&L statements, budgets, etc.) to ensure that each location meets its financial targets.
* Partner with the finance team to **set and track budgets** for the region, including forecasting for revenue, expenses, and labor.
* Implement initiatives to **increase sales, improve margins**, and ensure the overall financial health of all stores in the region.
* **Coach and mentor District Managers** (DMs) and other leadership team members to develop their skills and ensure effective leadership at all locations.
* Build a pipeline of talent by **recruiting, training, and developing** future leaders, ensuring all stores have strong management teams in place.
* Provide ongoing training and development to staff, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.
* Create a **positive and motivating work environment** that aligns with the companys values and encourages teamwork and high performance.
* Ensure that all restaurants deliver exceptional **guest experience** by consistently meeting or exceeding service standards.
* Monitor guest feedback through various channels (surveys, online reviews, etc.) and implement strategies to **improve guest satisfaction**.
* Work with restaurant teams to ensure **brand standards** are consistently upheld in areas such as cleanliness, hospitality, and food quality.
* Ensure all locations within the region adhere to **local, state, and federal regulations** (health, labor, and safety laws).
* Oversee safety protocols, including **food safety practices, cleanliness, and emergency procedures** to ensure a safe environment for both staff and guests.
* Lead the region in following **ethical business practices**, including adherence to all company policies and procedures.
* Develop and execute regional strategies that align with the overall **corporate goals** and brand vision.
* Partner with senior leadership to plan and roll out new **products, initiatives, and promotional campaigns** at the regional level.
* Collaborate with marketing, HR, and supply chain teams to ensure that all restaurants are **equipped for successful execution** of corporate strategies.
* Stay informed of industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics to **adapt strategies** accordingly.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience**: 8\-10 years of progressive experience in multi\-unit management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the QSR or hospitality industry.
* **Education**: Bachelors degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* **Leadership Skills**: Proven ability to lead and inspire teams, manage multiple restaurant locations, and build strong leadership teams.
* **Financial Acumen**: Strong understanding of financial management (P\&L analysis, budgeting, forecasting) and operational metrics.
* **Operational Expertise**: In\-depth knowledge of restaurant operations, including guest service, food safety, labor management, and compliance.
* **Problem\-Solving**: Ability to identify and solve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* **Communication Skills**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage at all organizational levels.
* **Adaptability**: Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment while managing competing priorities.
* **Technology Proficiency**: Comfortable using restaurant management software, financial analysis tools, and communication platforms.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Sales growth and profitability across all regional locations
* Labor cost management and efficiency
* Guest satisfaction scores.
* Operational compliance and health/safety audit results
* Employee retention and leadership development success

**Waving Manager**

**Monday\- Thursday**

**9:00 a.m. \- 7:00 p.m.**

  

A Waving Manager is responsible for managing the wave planning and execution process, which is crucial in ensuring that customer orders are released, picked, packed, and shipped in a timely and efficient manner.

  

Role of a Waving Supervisor

  

Wave Planning

* Analyze order volumes and shipping deadlines
* Coordinate with warehouse management systems (WMS) to create effective waves
* Prioritize high\-urgency or time\-sensitive orders


Execution Oversight

* Monitor real\-time progress of picking waves
* Adjust wave release timing to avoid bottlenecks in picking or packing areas
* Ensure labor is properly allocated across waves


Communication \& Coordination

* Work closely with:
	+ Inventory control
	+ Picking and packing supervisors
	+ Out bound teams
	+ Ensure smooth transitions from one operational step to another


System Management

* Use WMS or ERP systems to:
	+ Trigger waves
	+ Track wave status
	+ Troubleshoot system or order issues


Performance Monitoring

* Track metrics like:
	+ Wave completion times
	+ Order accuracy
	+ Throughput efficiency

  

Report issues or delays and recommend improvements

  

Key Skills Needed


Strong understanding of warehouse processes


WMS proficiency (e.g., Manhattan, SAP EWM, Oracle)


Attention to detail and problem\-solving


Communication and leadership skills


Ability to work under pressure in fast\-paced environments

The Waving Supervisor notices a surge in 2\-day delivery orders. They prioritize those orders into an early wave, coordinate with picking teams to start immediately, and ensure those packages reach the dock before the afternoon carrier cutoff.

**Position Description**
------------------------

  

  

**About Harris County and Universal Services:**
Harris County Universal Services (Universal Services) is transforming the way the County does business and seeking Manager, Asset Management to join our team.  

Universal Services is the enterprise IT solutions center for the departments and offices of Harris County, providing Information Technology, Public Safety and Justice Technologies, 311 Constituent Engagement Services, Fleet Services, and Records and Information Governance Services.
Harris County is the third largest and most diverse county in the nation, with a population of more than 4\.7 million. Harris County Commissioners Court, the County’s governing body, directs a budget of more than $4 billion providing essential services including flood control, infrastructure, healthcare, housing, and justice administration.  

This is a great opportunity to join Universal Services as we enhance critical services to Harris County residents and internal customers.  

The Manager, Enterprise Technology Asset Management, is responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operations, standards, controls, and continuous improvement of the Enterprise Technology Asset Management function within Universal Services. This position manages the core asset management team and oversees both Hardware Asset Management and Software Asset Management activities across the technology asset lifecycle.  

The role is responsible for ensuring technology assets are properly tracked, managed, optimized, and reported from request, procurement, receipt, inventory, deployment, assignment, transfer, recovery, refresh, and retirement tracking. The position also supports software and license management, including entitlement tracking, license utilization, compliance, renewals, optimization, and reporting. **Duties \& Responsibilities*** Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Enterprise Technology Asset Management team, including staffing, workload management, performance expectations, and operational priorities.
* Assist leadership in developing and maintaining asset management strategies, policies, procedures, standards, and best practices for County technology assets.
* Establish and maintain standardized asset lifecycle processes for hardware and software assets.
* Manage lifecycle activities for hardware assets, including laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, mobile devices, and other approved technology assets.
* Oversee asset intake, receiving, tagging, inventory validation, storage, staging, deployment tracking, assignment, transfer, recovery, refresh, and retirement tracking.
* Monitor warehouse and storage inventory to ensure accuracy, safety, efficiency, and appropriate chain\-of\-custody controls.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of hardware assets, including deployed, stored, pending deployment, recovered, retired, and exception status.
* Coordinate periodic inventory audits, reconciliation activities, data validation, and corrective action plans.
* Monitor aging hardware, warranty status, refresh eligibility, lifecycle replacement needs, and device standards.
* Support annual and multi\-year hardware refresh planning, budget inputs, and prioritization.
* Coordinate with approved operational or vendor teams responsible for physical disposal or salvage while ensuring asset records are reconciled and complete.
* Manage software asset management responsibilities, including license entitlement tracking, assignment tracking, utilization monitoring, renewal support, compliance, and optimization.
* Maintain visibility into enterprise and department\-used software assets, licenses, subscriptions, renewals, and usage data.
* Support software license reclamation, license reassignment, duplicate license reduction, and improved license utilization.
* Supervise responses to software vendor license compliance audits, license validation requests, and internal compliance reviews.
* Partner with procurement, finance, cybersecurity, architecture, departments, and vendors to support software standards, renewal planning, and compliance expectations.
* Support the development and maintenance of an approved software catalog and license management model.
* Produce recurring software and license reports showing utilization, compliance risks, renewal exposure, optimization opportunities, and corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate, complete, and timely reporting of asset and license data across asset management systems, procurement records, inventory repositories, and operational reports.
* Address data completeness and quality concerns through reconciliation, process controls, and corrective actions.
* Provide data analysis on asset value, asset status, lifecycle position, risk, utilization, and compliance.
* Support finance teams with data required for asset\-related budgets, business cases, lifecycle planning, and leadership reporting.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and recurring reports for inventory accuracy, deployment cycle time, recovery rate, refresh progress, license utilization, and audit readiness.
* Evaluate, support, maintain, and improve asset management\-related tools and services in coordination with approved technology implementation efforts.
* Ensure asset management tools align with organizational data sources and support reliable reporting.
* Recommend improvements to asset workflows, forms, reports, standard operating procedures, and controls.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining required documentation, evidence, logs, reports, and process records.
* Identify, document, and report breaches of asset management policy and track corrective actions to closure.
* Develop and report on remediation efforts related to asset risks, compliance gaps, inventory exceptions, and optimization opportunities.
* Partner with leadership, departments, procurement, finance, cybersecurity, architecture, Help Desk, Desktop Support, and vendors to support asset lifecycle control and accountability.
* Ensure asset management processes align with County policies, procurement requirements, cybersecurity standards, and operational needs.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the department.
* Support emergency, disaster, or urgent operational activities as required by Harris County and Universal Services.

 **Harris County is an Equal Opportunity Employer**  

https://hrrm.harriscountytx.gov/Pages/EqualEmploymentOpportunityPlan.aspx  

 If you need special services or accommodations, please call (713\) 274\-5445 or email ADACoordinator@bmd.hctx.net.  

**This position is subject to a criminal history check. Only relevant convictions will be considered and, even when considered, may not automatically disqualify the candidate.**
**Requirements**
----------------


**Education/Experience:*** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field;

**OR*** High School Diploma/GED with four years of related experience;

**OR*** Associate’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field with two years of related experience;

**OR*** Master’s degree in a directly related field may substitute for the required experience.

  

Applicants for this position will be subject to a criminal background check that includes being fingerprinted. This applies to any position with network access to Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) or access to an area where CJIS is received, maintained or stored either manually or electronically (i.e. custodian, maintenance).  

  

**Automatic Disqualification:*** Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for any Felony, and any Class A Misdemeanor
* Convictions, probation, or deferred adjudication for a Class B Misdemeanor, if within the previous 10 years
* Open arrest for any criminal offense (Felony or Misdemeanor)
* Family Violence conviction

You may attach a resume to the application as supporting documentation but **ONLY information stated on the application will be used for consideration. "See Resume"** **will not be accepted for qualifications.**
**Preferences**
---------------


* Experience managing Hardware Asset Management and Software Asset Management functions in a large enterprise or public sector environment.

description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game\-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

* **Curiosity**: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* **Collaboration**: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* **Commitment**: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.


WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.


Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. We are committed to creating a work environment that values, appreciates, and respects everyone, and we encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.


Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


A little bit about our team:


The WMX Finance team supports the global merchandising, artist services, and supply chain within WMX. We partner closely with commercial, creative, and operational leaders to drive financial performance, improve visibility across complex revenue streams, and enable scalable growth across touring, e\-commerce, retail, and licensing channels.


Your role


WMX is seeking a Senior Manager, Global Merch Finance to be responsible for the day\-to\-day financial operations and FP\&A processes for the global merchandising organization. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Global Merch Finance, this role acts as the analytical engine of the team ensuring forecasting accuracy, building robust financial models, and providing critical data support to help commercial and operational leaders optimize profitability across a multi\-channel global business.


Here you’ll get to:

* Partner directly with merchandising, e\-commerce, and commercial managers to help track, analyze, and translate business performance against financial goals.
* Prepare complex financial modeling and analysis for upcoming artist deals and new business opportunities, evaluating IRR, NPV, royalties, advances, recoupment, and profit share.
* Manage the day\-to\-day coordination and consolidation of the annual budget, quarterly forecasting cycles, and long\-range planning (LRP) for the US merchandising business.
* Variance \& KPI Tracking: Deliver detailed U,S monthly variance analysis and maintain operational dashboards tracking key indicators such as revenue per head, margins, inventory turns, and sell\-through.
* Analyze US tour profitability structures (venue commissions, per\-head metrics) and e\-commerce performance measurements (conversion, AOV, marketing ROI) to identify optimization areas.
* Coordinate with Accounting and Shared Services to support the monthly US close process, track cash flow forecasting, and ensure integrity in revenue recognition across business models.
* Support data flow improvements, system enhancements, and finance transformation initiatives to drive automation and scalable reporting solutions.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop a manager and a financial analyst, ensuring high\-quality outputs and clear career progression.


About you:

* 7–10 years (for Director) or 5–7 years (for Senior Manager) of progressive experience in Finance, FP\&A, or Accounting.
* Hands\-on experience supporting merchandising, e\-commerce, retail, or multi\-channel supply chain businesses.
* Strong financial modeling abilities, with practical experience calculating IRR, NPV, and ROI for business decisions
* Proven understanding of core corporate finance principles, including P\&L management, forecasting, and cash flow tracking.
* Direct experience managing, mentoring, or supervising junior analysts.
* Excellent technical proficiency in Excel, pivot tables and data manipulation.


We’d love it if you also had:

* Background in music, live entertainment, merchandising, or direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) channels.
* Experience working across international markets or matrixed corporate structures.
* CPA, CFA, or MBA qualification.
* Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and modern financial reporting/BI tools.
* Previous exposure to finance transformation, data migration, or process improvement projects.


Key attributes:

* Operationally minded with strong commercial foresight and attention to detail.
* Highly collaborative teammate who can easily build trust with cross\-functional peers.
* Proactive problem\-solver who enjoys rolling up their sleeves to dig into data.
* Comfortable leading multiple deadlines in a fast\-paced, fluid environment.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complex data into clear, actionable summaries.

  

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre\-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.


Together, we are **Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.**

**Love this job and want to apply?**


Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

  

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

  

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

HTP Energy is a privately\-owned wholesale energy supplier and distributor offering a robust suite of products and solutions to end\-users and suppliers across North America. We are a forward\-thinking company that values integrity, our diverse team, sustainability, and innovation. Headquartered in Onalaska, Wisconsin, our organization is a leader in our field with resources and additional opportunities in renewable energy, road construction and maintenance, aggregate, and emerging technology throughout the Midwest. **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Commodity Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing fuel pricing strategies to maximize profitability while remaining competitive in the marketplace. This role analyzes market trends, fuel costs, competitor pricing, and margin performance to establish fuel prices across a network of pipelines and terminal locations.  



This is a full\-time position located in Onalaska, WI with a Monday through Friday, daytime hours schedule. This position will also be responsible for:


* Execute pricing strategies that balance volume growth, market share, and profit objectives.
* Monitor daily wholesale fuel markets, rack pricing, and industry trends.
* Analyze competitor pricing and market conditions.
* Collaborate with operations, supply, scheduling, and marketing teams to support pricing decisions.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports on pricing performance.
* Evaluate the impact of market fluctuations, supply disruptions, and regulatory changes on fuel pricing.
* Conduct forecasting and trend analysis to support business planning.
* Ensure pricing compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.
* Maintain pricing databases and reporting tools.

Competitive wage and retirement program, health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance. Paid time off and holidays available immediately.

**The Role**



LeafLink seeks a highly skilled **Senior BSA/AML Analyst on a 6 month contact basis** with deep expertise in high\-risk complexity banking environments. In this role, you will own end to end financial crimes investigations across a diverse cannabis client portfolio, serving as subject matter expert on FinCEN guidance, state\-level MRB regulations, and the unique typologies that emerge when embedded banking infrastructure meets federally controlled industries. This is not a routine compliance role – it requires regulatory prowess, business judgement, and the ability to operate with ambiguity.


**This is a 6 month contract role with the potential to go full\-time.**


**What You'll Be Doing**


* Monitor and investigate AML alerts generated across multiple program partners.
* Monitor and investigate alerts related to negative news, OFAC and PEP screening, and license violations
* Conduct due diligence and ongoing monitoring of cannabis clients
* Prepare partner marijuana specific SAR reports in accordance with FinCEN's guidance in distinguishing limited filings, priority filings, and termination filings
* Support the development and calibration of transaction monitoring rules tailored to specific typologies
* Administer the end\-to\-end CRB onboarding and ongoing monitoring, including cannabis specific reviews, license verifications, and beneficial ownership analysis
* Conduct regular CRB account reviews – validating cash deposits, sales activity, and transaction patterns consistent with licensed operations
* Support partner bank regulatory examinations and internal/external audits; prepare materials and respond to examiner inquiries


**What You'll Bring to the Team**


* 5\+ years of BSA/AML compliance experience, fintech and cannabis banking a plus
* Experience filing marijuana\-related SARs under FinCEN's MRB guidance framework
* Demonstrated knowledge of BasS compliance models, including how AML obligations flow between partner programs
* Experience with AML transaction monitoring platforms (i.e. Abrigo BAM\+, Actimize, Verafin) and cannabis specific compliance tools (i.e. METRC, BioTrack, Shield Assure, RiskScout)
* Ability to review state cannabis license data, interpret dispensary, cultivator, processor operational structures, and assess alignment with banking activity
* CAMS certification a plus


*LeafLink's employee\-centric culture has earned us a coveted spot on**BuiltInNYC's Best Places to Work for in 2021 list.* *Learn more about LeafLink's history and the path to our First Billion in Wholesale Cannabis Orders**here**.*

**Mavericks Wanted**



When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on  

  

In 2015, we pioneered a "moneyball for biotech" approach, pooling projects and promising early\-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life\-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  

  

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical \& thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

### **What You will Do**



The Skeletal Dysplasia Account Manager is a high\-impact, community\-focused role central to BridgeBio's commercial success. This individual will drive the launch of Infigratinib—a first\-in\-class therapy for achondroplasia—bring deep clinical acumen, urgency, and a passion for partnering with providers and families.

  


### **Location**



Central Region \~ Multiple territories covering the following areas:



Chicago, Minneapolis, Indianapolis, Cincinnati, Detroit, Kansas City

  


**Responsibilities**


* Develop and execute a dynamic territory business plan targeting geneticists, pediatric endocrinologists, orthopedic specialists, pediatricians, and multi\-disciplinary skeletal dysplasia clinic teams to meet and exceed sales goals.
* Demonstrate deep expertise in Infigratinib, achondroplasia, and the broader skeletal dysplasia landscape; engage HCPs in clinically relevant, compliant discussions.
* Use sales and target data to identify growth opportunities and address territory challenges proactively.
* Anticipates potential business challenges, adjusts priorities as needed, demonstrates flexibility, and develops solutions to address challenges.
* Partners compliantly with Field Medical Directors, Field Reimbursement Managers, Family Account Managers, and the HUB to maximize customer and family satisfaction.
* Build and maintain relationships with KOLs in partnership with Marketing and Medical Affairs to expand advocacy for Infigratinib and BridgeBio.
* Operate with an "One Bridge" mindset—collaborating across the organization to execute company initiatives and represent BridgeBio with integrity.
* Maintains an exceptional level of proficiency in selling skills, clinical, market and product knowledge and the business environment of the territory.
* Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulations, company policies, and Pharma guidelines.

  


### **CRITICAL CAPABILITIES**

  


**Competitive Mindset**


* **Business Acumen \& Results Orientation:** Balances priorities and leverages available resources to drive results; applies strong analytical skills to surface opportunities in the skeletal dysplasia market.
* **Resilience \& Confidence:** Hunter's mentality with the resilience to identify and support families living with achondroplasia across geographically dispersed centers of care.


**Customer Focus**


* **Build Trusting Relationships:** Trusted advisor who anticipates and addresses the needs of skeletal dysplasia providers, genetic counselors, and families.
* **Clinical Acumen \& Learning Agility:** Continuously deepens clinical knowledge of achondroplasia; sought out as a condition and product expert by HCPs and their teams.


**Key Account Success**


* **Influence with Impact:** Engages multidisciplinary care teams—from geneticists to orthopedic specialists to community advocacy groups—with credible, complex influence strategies.
* **Teamwork and Coordination:** Prioritizes the community and business while collaborating closely with the Regional Sales Director and cross\-functional partners to execute a successful launch.

  


### **Who You Are**


* 8–10 years in pharmaceutical or biotech; 4\+ years in rare disease, genetic disease, or skeletal dysplasia required. Achondroplasia or pediatric rare disease experience highly preferred.
* BS/BA required, MBA a plus.
* Willingness to travel extensively.
* **Product/indication launch experience:** Proven record of accomplishment launching products into competitive or new markets, including creating demand through disease\-state and stakeholder education.
* **Account management:** Success analyzing complex accounts, building strategy, and driving implementation to deliver measurable impact.
* **Leadership \& communication:** Effective communication skills and influence, both internally and externally—with high accountability, sound judgment, and excellent organizational skills.
* **AI fluency:** Demonstrated curiosity and adaptability with AI\-powered tools and technologies.
* **Integrity:** Commitment to BridgeBio's ethical standards and compliance culture.

**As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.** **We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.**


**For Full\-Time U.S Based Roles:**


**Financial \& Rewards**


* **Market\-leading compensation**
* **401(k) with employer match**
* **Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)**
* **Pre\-tax commuter benefits** (transit and parking)
* **Referral bonus** for hired candidates
* **Subsidized lunch and parking** on in\-office days


**Health \& Well\-Being**


* **100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums** for you **and** your dependents
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)** with annual employer contributions, plus **Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)**
* **Fertility \& family\-forming benefits**

 * **Expanded mental health support** (therapy and coaching resources)
* **Hybrid work model** with flexibility
* **Flexible, "take\-what\-you\-need" paid time off** and company\-paid holidays

**Location:**This position follows a hybrid schedule, with team members working onsite four days per week from any of our BDA offices in Indianapolis, IN; Troy, MI; Woodinville, WA; Austin, TX; or Atlanta, GA.


**Position Summary**



In this role, you are both strategic and sales\-driven to manage and grow a portfolio of high\-value enterprise and hybrid accounts within the branded merchandise industry. This role requires a deep understanding of the promotional products space, strong enterprise\-level relationship management, and a proven ability to drive revenue growth through strategic planning, value\-driven selling, and cross\-functional collaboration.



You must be both a strategist and a closer and thrive on expanding client relationships, exceeding sales goals, and delivering creative solutions that align with brand compliance and client marketing objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Sales \& Account Growth**


* Prepare and maintain an actionable strategic account plan using the OST model (Objective, Strategy, Tactics) for all assigned accounts focused on quarterly budget attainment (profit and margin results).
* Own and exceed sales and margin goals across assigned accounts.
* Identify new opportunities within existing accounts to drive incremental revenue through strategic prospecting and relationship building.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, aligning merchandise strategies with their broader marketing and brand objectives.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Account Business Reviews (ABRs), delivering insights, performance metrics, and strategic roadmaps.
* Forecast revenue and contribute to long\-term strategic planning for key accounts.
* Ensure data hygiene guideline compliance. Manage all opportunities, tasks, and key performance indicators to prescribed guidelines through insights from Salesforce CRM, promo and program performance analysis, and proactive recommendations.


**Client Relationship \& Brand Stewardship**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact.
* Ensure full compliance with brand guidelines, contracts, and program standards.
* Deliver proactive, solutions\-oriented support to meet evolving client needs, acting as both consultant and problem\-solver.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Creative, Merchandising, Programs, Sales Ops, Supplier Relations, and other internal teams to deliver a best\-in\-class client experience.
* Develop merchandise strategies that reflect market trends and elevate the client's brand.
* Coordinate and manage multiple complex projects with varying scopes, timelines, and logistical considerations.


**Operational Execution**

* Ensure client pre\-sale, order and approval processes, supplier compliance standards and production timeline expectations are met
* Ensure all project communications, updates, and deliverables meet client and internal expectations.
* Accurately log and manage account activity in Salesforce to ensure full pipeline visibility and performance tracking.


**Client Events \& Onboarding**


* Successfully onboard new enterprise clients, ensuring a smooth and strategic launch.
* Coordinate and attend client events as needed, ensuring high satisfaction and brand alignment.
* Participation in departmental and other meetings as required
* Other duties as assigned by direct manager, sales leadership and/or executive team


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in the branded merchandise/promotional products industry preferred.
* Proven track record of sales success and strategic account growth.
* Exceptional communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and ability to navigate sensitive client interactions.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
* High level of curiosity, accountability, and a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time.

**Commercial Account Manager**

**About Site**


Catalent's Chelsea, Massachusetts site (Greater Boston area) specializes in inhalation and oral drug development and manufacturing, with expertise in spray dry dispersion, dry powder inhalers, and bioavailability enhancement technologies. The site supports programs from development through commercial manufacturing and serves as a key part of Catalent's global oral and specialty delivery network.

**Position Summary**


We have an opportunity for a Commercial Account Manager to join our team and act as the primary site contact for assigned customer accounts. In this role, you will ensure customer satisfaction by managing the commercial process and driving continuous improvement. You will build strong relationships with key stakeholders and provide a consistent experience while promoting the Catalent brand. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment and values collaboration and accountability.

**Shift:** Monday – Friday 1st shift  

**Location:** 100% onsite at our facility in Chelsea, MA

**The Role**

* Serve as the primary commercial contact for assigned customer accounts, acting as the voice of the customer, and ensuring successful execution of commercial manufacturing programs.
* Partner with customers, operations, planning, finance, quality, and supply chain teams to align forecasts, demand plans, and production requirements.
* Lead onboarding and integration of new commercial clients as programs transition from development and PPQ into routine commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and implement scalable account management, forecasting, and planning processes to support the site's continued commercial growth.
* Drive cross\-functional communication, issue resolution, and strategic relationship management while balancing customer expectations with operational capabilities.
* Perform additional duties as needed.
**Candidate Minimum****Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree is required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in commercial account management, strategic account management, commercial operations, customer\-facing operations, supply chain, planning, or related client\-facing roles.
* Experience managing customer relationships and coordinating across multiple internal stakeholders in a manufacturing, CDMO, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other complex operational environment.
* Experience supporting forecasting, demand planning, SIOP/S\&OP, or commercial execution activities.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems, and operate effectively in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with ERP systems preferred.
**Preferred Skills \& Background**

* Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, CDMO/CMO, life sciences, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience owning customer forecasts and aligning demand with operational capacity.
* Participation in SIOP/S\&OP processes or similar integrated business planning activities.
* Experience developing, improving, or implementing business processes in a growing organization.
* Knowledge of PPQ, commercial manufacturing, inhalation products, oral solid dose (OSD), or related pharmaceutical operations is preferred but not required.
* Experience with inhalation, spray drying, or OTC products is a plus.
 **Compensation**


The anticipated salary range for this position in Massachusetts is **$90,000 – $120,000****plus eligibility for****a bonus**. The final salary offered to a successful candidate may vary, and will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and length of experience within the job, type and length of experience within the industry, skillset, education, business needs, etc. Catalent is a multi\-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

**Why you should join Catalent**

* Opportunity to play a key role in driving growth within a global CDMO leader.
* Competitive compensation package, including incentive opportunity.
* Day\-one medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities.
* Generous paid time off and holiday schedule (152 hours \+ 8 holidays.)
* Collaborative, mission\-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes worldwide.

  



**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life\-saving and life\-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.
