9th Way Insignia is a service\-disabled, veteran\-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions. Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/.



Application password: Niner

### **Project Introduction**



The Data Management Center (DMC) Application Development and Sustainment project provides enterprise software development, modernization, and data governance support for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Academic Affiliations (OAA). The program sustains and modernizes a portfolio of approximately twelve custom\-built .NET web applications, Microsoft Power Platform solutions, SharePoint sites, SSRS and Power BI reports, and supporting SQL Server databases that enable OAA's health professions education, Advanced Fellowship, and trainee management mission. Work includes migration to the VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC) using Microsoft Azure, SSRS\-to\-Power BI and WebForms\-to\-ASP.NET Core modernization, enterprise data governance toward Level 4\-5 CMMI target operating maturity, Section 508 accessibility compliance, and continuous sustainment of the active VA\-wide umbrella ATO (FIPS 199 Moderate). DMC personnel support both day\-to\-day operations and strategic modernization initiatives in alignment with VA policies, VAEC standards, and Government\-approved governance processes. All work is performed at the Contractor's facility.


### **Professional Level**



The Graphic Designer aligns as an L2 Consultant position at 9th Way Insignia. The position supports the VA Office of Academic Affiliations Data Management Center (DMC) on a part\-time, level\-of\-effort basis not to exceed 250 hours per year. This role designs and implements accessible, visually appealing, and user\-friendly interfaces for OAA applications and platforms. The Graphic Designer creates user\-centered designs using Bootstrap, jQuery, and centralized CSS files, and collaborates with front\-end and back\-end developers to integrate designs within the .NET Core C\# and Microsoft Power Platform environment. All designs must meet Section 508, ADA, and WCAG 2\.0 Level A and AA accessibility requirements.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design and implement accessible, visually appealing, and user\-friendly interfaces for OAA applications and platforms.
* Create user\-centered designs using Bootstrap, jQuery, and centralized CSS files.
* Collaborate with front\-end and back\-end developers to integrate designs within the .NET Core C\# and Power Platform environment.
* Create additional website graphics as needed using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or other graphic design tools.
* Ensure all designs meet Section 508, ADA, and WCAG 2\.0 Level A and AA compliance requirements.
* Maintain visual consistency and design standards across the OAA application portfolio.
* Support wireframing, site diagrams, and site maps in coordination with the Business Analyst.
* Remediate accessibility findings in existing UI and graphic assets.
* Manage assigned work within an annual level of effort not to exceed 250 hours.

### **Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field. No equivalencies or substitutions for the degree requirement will be accepted.
* Four (4\) or more years of experience as a graphic designer focusing on user\-centered design and accessibility.
* Proficiency in Bootstrap, jQuery, and centralized CSS files.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Demonstrated experience designing to Section 508 / WCAG 2\.0 AA standards.
* Ability to work effectively on a part\-time, task\-based level of effort.
* Must have resided continuously in the United States for the past 36 months.
* U.S. Citizenship required.

### **Preferred/Desired**


* Section 508 Compliance certifications or formal accessibility training.
* Experience designing within Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps) and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting federal agencies or large enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS).
* Experience with responsive design for legacy .NET applications.

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.*

**About the Role**
------------------


Total Wine \& More is seeking a **Senior Graphic Designer** to join our in\-house creative team in Bethesda, MD. This role will help shape captivating visual experiences across multiple channels including web and digital display. As a member of our design team, you will be an integral part of our marketing communications efforts responsible for design solutions that resonate with our customers and drive engagement. The ideal candidate will be a creative powerhouse with an eye for detail and a passion for visual storytelling. You will report to the Creative Manager, Web and Display.

**You will**
------------

* Think strategically to translate briefs into effective digital design solutions, balancing creativity, usability, performance, and customer needs in service of business goals.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional partners (marketing, digital merchandising, UX, operations) to align on best practices and incorporate feedback to ensure work flows smoothly from concept through execution.
* Contribute to the development of campaign creative concepts that drive cohesive storytelling and consistency across digital and print experiences.
* Drive brand consistency and a seamless customer experience across digital channels by implementing best practices, processes, and partnerships that improve efficiency and performance within assigned channels.

**You will come with**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or related field preferred or equivalent years of experience
* 1\-4 years of Digital Design experience preferably in a marketing communications/in\-house agency environment
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) and Figma, with the ability to translate concepts into polished, production ready digital assets

* Strong eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and design principles that support clear storytelling and contribute to customer engagement and click‑through rates
* A strong understanding of WCAG accessibility standards, ADA\-compliant design, and inclusive design practices for web and display experiences
* Power user of Mac\-based OS
* Experience developing animation is an added bonus
* Retail experience and knowledge of the wine \& spirits industry a plus

**We offer**
------------

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Generous store discounts
* Health care plans (medical, prescription, dental, vision)
* 401(k), HSA, FSA, Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Disability \& life insurance coverage
* Paid parental leave
* Pet insurance
* Critical illness and accident insurance
* Discounted home and auto insurance
* College tuition assistance
* Career development \& product training
* Consumer classes
* *\& More!*

Does your current company inspire you to build, grow, and innovate? Is your passion for making lasting and meaningful change being realized?  



The tremendous growth in our business and increasing demand for our services means we are expanding our team in exciting ways. We have the heart of a startup and the backing of an industry leader. This means a unique career opportunity for low\-ego professionals looking for a people\-first, culture rich work family with which to change the world.


**Summary:**

Centro Benefits Research is an employee benefits service organization which provides research, analysis, and process facilitation for employee benefits consultants and insurance carriers. Insurance is complicated and often painful for those who deal with the processes which has not quite caught up with digital technology advances. Our mission is to bring modern technology to a legacy insurance process and help all stakeholders work more efficiently for the benefits of millions of working Americans depending on building their financial security through benefits offered at work.


In February 2020 our small team have joined OneDigital, one of the largest leading Benefits and HR Consulting firm in the country to help us realize the full potential of our vision and a mission of standing up a ground breaking digital platform that helps advance the industry into the future of how employee benefits are managed.


With a tremendous growth in our business and increasing demand for our services, we are expending the team and seeking **User** **Experience Designer Lead** to join our Product Team. In this role, you will collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering and Business Teams to help shape the vision and the feature functionality for the new digital platform connecting multiple stakeholders and partners in the process of creating and delivering employee benefits for thousands of small employers and millions of working Americans. Our platform will be used by employee benefits consultants and brokers, insurance carriers, and other service providers to deliver modern digital and connected experience to all.


This is a new role with a newly created team of digital product and technology enthusiasts on a mission to solve big problems. You will work with a high degree of autonomy collaborating with like\-minded teammates building software from the ground\-up.


If you are a brave and tenacious team player with a passion for innovation, problem solving, challenging the status quo, and always looking for a better way of doing things, you will love working here.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):**

* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to distill complex problems and propose simple, elegant design solutions
* Design impactful User Interfaces, clever and effective interaction patterns which help establish digital process familiarity
* Research, define and maintain user personas, user mental models, and user journey maps
* Develop and maintain design principles, style guide and pattern library to be used in all design, prototyping, and front\-end engineering functions
* Translate from sketch to specs complex business workflows into user flows, wireframes, interaction models, hi\-fi user interface prototypes, and engineering ready delivery assets following the Agile development process.
* Be the customer advocate to drive relentless focus on the user and their desires, thinking, constraints, opportunities.
* Plan appropriate type and execute necessary customer research including: Concept, Heuristic, Usability, A/B Testing
* Using design thinking techniques collaborate across various stakeholders to influence strategy and roadmap
* Constantly improve technical acumen to maintain awareness of current and emerging front\-end code capabilities and constraints across all standards to ensure technical business needs are met while maintaining a strong focus on the user experience

**Qualifications, Skills and Requirements:**

* Very strong data visualization skills
* Ability to present design ideas clearly and effectively to help stakeholders make decisions.
* Understanding and hands on experience with UX research methodologies and ability to execute them if needed.
* Working experience with Figma, Sketch, Adobe CS, and InVision
* Practical understanding of the latest technologies used to build rich web, desktop, and mobile apps (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, React, APIs)
* Extremely high attention to detail in planning, managing, producing, and polishing design deliverables
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and leadership skills
* Ability to prioritize effectively
* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Enjoys being part of a small team with a big mission

**Education, Training and Experience:**

* Hands on Designer Experience with solid technical background
* 4 years of demonstrated experience solving complex design problems for Web or software solutions for data intensive and transaction\-oriented applications
* Deep understanding of Design principles and their application
* Experience in direct, hands\-on collaboration with developers, business analysts, product managers
* Expertise in defining and implementing user experience design and brand guidelines
* Experience in conceptual development and rapid creative prototyping as well as tactical UI design and implementation
* Solid experience with all phases of UX process: sketching, wireframing, prototyping, site mapping, user journey mapping, user flows, user testing

Your base pay is dependent upon your skills, education, qualifications, professional experience, and location. In addition to base pay, some roles are eligible for variable compensation, commission, and/or annual bonus based on your individual performance and/or the company’s performance. We also offer eligible employees health, wellbeing, retirement, and other financial benefits, paid time off, overtime pay for non\-exempt employees, and robust learning and development programs. You will receive reimbursement of job\-related expenses per the company policy and may receive employee perks and discounts.
  

  

To learn more, visit: www.onedigital.com/careers


Thank you for your interest in joining the team!

**Detailed Description:**

* Lead the design process across web and mobile experiences: discovery research, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and validation through usability testing.
* Partner daily with product managers and engineers to ship features — you’ll be embedded in the team, not handing off from a distance.
* Collaborate with teammates who support user interviews and research logistics, shaping study plans together and turning findings into design decisions the team can act on.
* Establish and maintain our first design system spanning web and mobile, building on existing design documentation and workflow definitions the team has already started.
* Advocate for users in roadmap and prioritization discussions, bringing evidence to the table.
* Help define how design works here — processes, tools, and critique culture as the team grows.

Perform additional duties as required and assigned.  

* 

**Job Requirements:**

* 3–5 years of product design experience, ideally with at least some of it on B2B or enterprise software.
* Experience designing for both web and mobile, with a solid grasp of responsive design and platform conventions (iOS/Android).
* A portfolio showing end\-to\-end work: the problem, your process, and shipped outcomes — not just polished screens.
* Comfort working independently and making decisions without a design manager reviewing every step.
* Hands\-on experience with modern design tools (e.g., Figma) and familiarity with how designs translate to front\-end implementation.
* Experience running or contributing to user research and usability testing.
* Strong communication skills — able to explain design rationale to engineers, PMs, and executives alike.
* Demonstrates positive collaboration skills: communicates effectively, builds relationships across functions, and takes an interest in team members’ success.

**Minimum Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field (Required).
* 3–5 years of product design experience (Required).
Portfolio of shipped product work demonstrating end\-to\-end design process (Required).  
* 

**Additional Details:**The UX Designer works with significant autonomy as the first dedicated designer on the team. The incumbent is expected to establish and drive design processes, make independent design decisions, and present rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders. Work is evaluated on the quality and impact of shipped product experiences and the effectiveness of the design system and processes established.  



**Nice to Have:**

* Experience building or significantly contributing to a design system.
* Prior experience as an early or solo designer at a company.
* Familiarity with complex workflows, data\-heavy interfaces, or admin tooling.

**Why This Role:**

* Real ownership, real support. Your design decisions ship, and you set the direction — backed by teammates who already help with research, documentation, and workflows.
* Visible impact. In enterprise software, good UX is a genuine differentiator — your work directly affects whether customers succeed with our product.
* Room to grow. As the first designer, you’re positioned to shape and eventually lead the design function as we scale.
* Hybrid flexibility. Work from our Houston office part of the week, from home the rest.

HI! I'm Dylan, one of the engineering managers at EnsoData and we are looking for another great teammate passionate about Making Healthcare Better. This hybrid position in Madison, WI offers a competitive salary of $135,000 to $145,000 along with bonus program, stock options and generous benefits, including paid time off.


The User Experience (UX) Designer is dedicated to improving customer and developer efficiency in our user interfaces through workflow and visual design. The person in this role will be responsible for understanding the needs of our users and translating these insights into well\-designed workflow steps and user screens. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing, to create user\-centered designs for our web and mobile applications. Your expertise will guide the design process from initial research and ideation through to wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.


Primary Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Conduct user research to identify user workflow needs.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs for web and mobile applications.
* Collaborate with customers, product managers and developers to ensure design feasibility and alignment with project goals.
* Perform usability testing to gather feedback and iterate on designs.
* Develop and maintain design systems and guidelines that ensure consistency across products.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies to inform design strategies.
* Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders, clearly articulating design decisions.


About EnsoData
EnsoData strives to make healthcare more accurate, efficient, and affordable through waveform artificial intelligence (AI) technology. Using AI and machine learning, our software analyzes billions of data points collected from sensors placed throughout the human body. Our first solution, EnsoSleep, reduces the time clinicians spend analyzing, scoring and managing sleep studies. This results in a simplified and accelerated patient testing, diagnosis, and treatment workflow. Our AI\-powered technology has the capability of informing health decisions beyond sleep medicine, from monitoring patient health in the ICU or through wearables, to detecting and capturing seizure data, to providing earlier detection of heart disease, diabetes, stroke, and Alzheimer’s.


Here is a little about what we are doing in the world of sleep medicine...


EnsoHST\- FDA\-Cleared, AI\-Powered Sleep Diagnosis Using Pulse Oximeters


EnsoSleep \- FDA\-Cleared PSG and HSAT Scoring and Study Management


\*\*Here is a link to learn a little about our Celeste app!

 **Requirements**  

Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as graphic design, computer science, or marketing
* Mobile app design
* User Experience Design certification is a bonus
* Healthcare technology experience is a bonus
* Experience using AI tools in a design or product workflow is a bonus


Qualifications

* 5\+ years’ experience as a User Experience Designer, Interaction Designer, or similar role, with on\-the\-job experience or formal education such as a UX design certificate or degree.
* Portfolio showcasing several user experience projects and design solutions.
* Proficiency in design and prototyping tools used with React, React Native, and mobile apps, Figma, and the Material UI design library.
* Experience with user research methodologies, usability testing, and data analysis.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for close collaboration with developers.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present and justify design decisions effectively.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.
* Comfort using AI tools to support research, ideation, UX copy, and documentation in daily design work.


We will give preference to candidates located in WI and in the Midwest US.


We'd love for you to demonstrate:

* Taste: has a breadth of experience considering how user goals inform workflows in web and mobile applications. Uses a variety of these applications and can use workflows from those apps as metaphor.
* Visually Sophisticated: Possesses a keen sense of design aesthetics, with a deep understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, color theory, and composition. Can apply design principles to create clear, effective, and well\-designed user interfaces that meet user needs.
* Communication: Ability to communicate in a remote environment that strives to be diverse and inclusive in addition to clear written and verbal communication.
* Passionate: You want to make a positive difference in the global healthcare landscape.
* AI\-Fluent**:** Thoughtfully incorporates AI tools into the design process to move faster and explore more, while keeping a critical eye on quality, accessibility, and whether the output actually serves the user. Knows when AI is the right lever and when it isn't.

**Company Culture \- Embrace the Pineapple! How do we do this?**

**Make Healthcare Better** \- is passionate about moving healthcare to a better place for everyone everywhere

**Put Customers First** \- delights customers by working closely with them to support their initiatives

**Be a Great Teammate** \- spreads the good vibes and is a joy to work with; also understands the value of helping one's teammates

**Gets $\#!t Done** \- bias toward action and intrinsically motivated to go above and beyond; demonstrates the ability to work autonomously as well as across teams


We also practice a **Focus on Quality** and look for teammates who don't cut corners and demonstrate integrity and attention to detail

 **Benefits**  

The benefits package includes, but is not limited to, the following:

**Hybrid/Remote Company** \- we are a company with hybrid and remote options. That being said, we have an amazing office headquarters in downtown Madison, WI with views of the capitol that you are welcome to work from at anytime. In case you didn't know, Madison has consistently been ranked as one of the top places to live in the US (businessinsider.com, money.com, livability.com)!

**Health, dental, and vision insurance** with options to choose a plan that fits you and your dependents needs.

**Paid time off options** \- we want our employees to rest, recharge, and feel better.

**Stock options** \- we want team members to feel ownership in the organization. When EnsoData does well, you do well.

**Company Bonus Program** \- if we do well, we want to reward our team members! This position may include participation in the company bonus program.

**401k** to help people invest in the future.

**Team Summits!** We look forward to opportunities to gather in person and enjoy a few days together. We participate in team events and gain some great in\-person time. (Hint: check out our blog for info from former team gatherings!)

**Interview Process**

* Submit a resume online and our hiring team will choose those that seem like the best candidates.
* We look forward to meeting you face\-to\-face! A few candidates will be chosen for a video call to get to know each other, discuss your experience, and explain the position in more detail.
* Expect an opportunity to show your skills.
* The final candidates will have a chance to meet a few people from the team.
* Offer!

**Let’s talk**

  

EnsoData seeks to recruit, hire, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. If you think you’re a great fit, but don't necessarily check every box on the job description, please still get in touch.


To learn more about our ongoing commitment to diversity, see our updated website here.


Note: this role is based in the continental United States and currently EnsoData is unable to support sponsorships so candidates must be legally eligible to work and reside in the United States now and in the future.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

  

EnsoData is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against, nor do we tolerate unlawful harassment against, team members or any other covered persons on any basis of race, color, protective hairstyles, national, social, or ethnic origin, gender, pregnancy, childbirth, gender orientation, identity or expression, sexual, relationship, or romantic orientation, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, family or parental status, age, protected veteran status, arrest record, expunged or sealed convictions, criminal history, source of income, credit history, housing status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, medical condition, genetic information, religion, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.


We value, celebrate, and support diversity, inclusion, and our differences. We are committed to providing a safe work environment and a company culture of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates. We seek to recruit, hire, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, intersectional individuals, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply. We have a deep conviction that diversity and inclusion among our teams, our communities, and our physical and virtual workplaces is vital to the success of EnsoData’s mission to improve healthcare access, outcomes, and affordability for patients and communities everywhere globally.


If you are a job seeker applying to EnsoData and you feel that you need to request an accommodation or alternative application, please contact Angela at angela@ensodata.com.

**Position Overview**

**Job Title:** Short\-Form Video Producer \& Digital Content Contractor

**Company:** JUS Official Services

**Department:** Creative Production Division

**Employment Type:** Independent Contractor (1099\)

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** Performance\-Based Commission Structure (Upfront Signing Bonuses \+ Ongoing Revenue Share)

**Company Description**

JUS Official Services is an independent Talent Management \& Growth Firm specializing in the identification, strategic development, and commercial scaling of unsigned independent musical artists, songwriters, producers, and vocalists. We bridge the gap between creative raw talent and commercial viability by handling brand strategy, digital marketing, playlist synchronization, and industry networking. To support our upcoming client acquisition pipeline, the Creative Production Division is immediately onboarding a remote Short\-Form Video Producer to manage the content development strategy across our corporate digital channels.

**Comprehensive Compensation and Contract Structure**

Please review the following structural parameters thoroughly prior to submitting an application. This position is structured strictly as an Independent Contractor (1099\) role operating on a pure\-commission model within the Creative Production Division.

* There is no base salary, hourly wage, or guaranteed financial draw associated with this contract.
* Financial compensation is derived directly from the quantifiable conversion of leads generated by the contractor's creative output.

**Financial Incentives**

* **The Client Signing Bonus:** The contractor will receive a flat cash bonus of \[$50\.00 \- $100\.00] immediately upon the execution of a formal management contract by an independent artist who entered the JUS Official Services acquisition funnel via the contractor's video content.
* **Ongoing Management Revenue Share:** The contractor will receive a \[25%] share of the firm's gross management revenue generated by the signed artist for the initial 12 months of that artist’s contractual tenure. This revenue share applies to all monetized streams handled by the firm, including digital streaming royalties, live performance bookings, merchandise sales, and synchronization licensing.

**Lead Attribution and Verification Tracking**

To ensure transparency and operational accuracy, JUS Official Services utilizes a systematic attribution ledger.

* **Distinct Asset Coding:** The contractor will be assigned specific behavioral call\-to\-actions and unique inbound phrases to embed within each video script.
* **Direct Application Mapping:** Prospective clients responding to these indicators will be routed to a dedicated digital intake system where data attribution is automatically captured.
* **Shared Performance Ledger:** The contractor will maintain view\-only access to a corporate tracking ledger updating the pipeline status of all incoming artists in real time, from initial review to final contract signing.

**Primary Responsibilities and Scope of Work**

The contractor will be responsible for the execution of the following digital workflows under the Creative Production Division:

* **High\-Volume Content Production:** Script, asset\-source, edit, and deliver four to five high\-retention vertical videos per week optimized for JUS Official Services official Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts accounts.
* **Algorithmic Architecture Optimization:** Implement precision editing techniques designed to maximize viewer retention metrics, including the deployment of dynamic visual hooks in the initial two seconds, pattern\-interrupts every three seconds, and synchronized sound design.
* **Market Research \& Scriptwriting:** Monitor shifts in the independent music sector to identify recurring creator pain points (e.g., streaming platform saturation, complex distribution mechanics, marketing fatigue) and convert these insights into educational or provocative video scripts.
* **Brand Asset Management:** Organize all project video files, captions, and metadata within a shared corporate repository for administrative approval and publishing.

**Professional Qualifications and Requirements**

* **Technical Capability:** Advanced proficiency in professional non\-linear video editing software (e.g., CapCut Desktop, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro) alongside a strong working knowledge of generative AI video tools (e.g., Creatify, Invideo).
* **Industry Acumen:** A documented understanding of contemporary music industry mechanics, digital streaming platforms, and independent artist pain points.
* **Autonomy and Pacing:** Demonstrated ability to manage independent production schedules and meet strict weekly deadlines without direct physical oversight.
* **Immediate Availability:** Readiness to initiate the creative onboarding sequence and deliver initial production assets to the Creative Production Division within the current calendar week.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates are requested to submit their application via LinkedIn message or corporate outreach. Please omit traditional resume formats and instead include the following items for evaluation:

* A brief professional introduction outlining your specific interest or background within the music entertainment sector.
* A direct hyperlink to a digital portfolio containing at least two completed examples of short\-form vertical videos edited by you that showcase rapid text pacing, dynamic hook placement, and professional sound layering.

Candidates whose portfolios meet the technical criteria will be contacted via chat within 24 hours to execute a brief, practical 15\-second video editing test before a final agreement is issued.

**Position Title****:** Photo Associate (Part\-time, Permanent)

**Department:** Sales and Marketing \- Ticketing


**Classification:** Part\-time, non\-exempt

The Photo Associate creates lasting photo memories for Mississippi Aquarium guests while providing excellent customer service. This position requires high energy, goal\-oriented, and sales\-driven individuals who have experience working with a high volume of customers. This is an entry level position that provides digital photography, staging, lighting, and capturing memorable experiences. Selected candidates will be expected to work alongside the Ticketing Team and other departments at the Mississippi Aquarium.

  



**II.****Responsibilities**

*Photo Capture*


1\. Setup and operate digital photography equipment.


2\. Adjust lighting levels and exposures in all types of weather.


3\. Stage and pose guests at capture locations.


4\. Ensure photo operations run smoothly and effectively.


5\. Create campus engagement opportunities for guests.


6\. Capture candid employee and ambassador animals.


7\. Work with guests of all ages and diverse backgrounds.

*Sales*


1\. Deliver effective sales and upsell photo packages


2\. Operate and maintain a Photo Point of Sale (POS) system that includes photo editing, printing, sorting, and packaging.


3\. Present and describe retail displays on photo kiosks to customers.


4\. Increase knowledge of financial projections, spending per person, sales tracking, and reporting for commissions.


*Guest Experience*


1\. Greet and welcome guests to the aquarium with a friendly and welcoming demeanor.


2\. Answer guest questions regarding a wide variety of aquarium topics and assist in wayfinding around the aquarium.


3\. Direct guests to photo locations.


4\. Ensure excellent customer service that exceeds MSAQ’s standards of excellence.


5\. Handle guest and staff disputes with professionalism and empathy.


6\. Monitor and control guest flow into small spaces around the aquarium.


7\. Work in a collaborative team environment, cross\-train and support all other Guest Experience areas.


8\. Attend all relevant meetings and training.


9\. Assist in daily operations, including opening and closing.


10\. Work weekends, evenings, and holidays when necessary.

 **III.****Requirements**

**1\.**Minimum of 1\-year customer service experience.

**2\.**Minimum high school diploma or GED.

**3\.**Must have excellent customer service skills.


**4\.**Working knowledge of digital photography.


**5\.**Must be able to work in adverse weather conditions, as well as remain in one area for large blocks of time.


**6\.**Ability to work independently and part of a team.


**7\.**Strong public speaking skills and a desire to work with the public.

 Consistently looking forward, focused, and ready to listen.

 Ability to communicate needs and issues effectively.


 Highly organized self\-starter that is able to maintain high standards.


 Innovative, creative thinker; not afraid to propose something new and inspire others to do the same.


 Proactive in finding solutions, productive, and efficient.

 **Team Requirements**


 1\. **Safety \& Security** \- All Team Members are required to adhere to all Mississippi Aquarium safety and security standards.


 2\. **Attendance \& Appearance** \- To maximize the guest’s experience, all Team Members are required to adhere to Mississippi Aquarium standard operating procedures regarding attendance and dress code policies as it relates to individual job functionality.


 3\. **Sales \& Guest Services** \- Our forward\-thinking business model requires listening and understanding the needs of our guests both internal and external. To that end, we must

Working closely with other creative thinkers, you'll put animation principles and visual storytelling into practice to bring ideas and concepts to life through motion. * **3–5 years of professional experience** as a motion designer, ideally in an agency, studio, or in\-house creative team

**About Mainstay Digital**

We create high\-end 3D experiences for B2B clients, from interactive videos and 3D product animations to AR demos and product stills. Our work helps technical sales teams showcase complex products in immersive, accessible ways.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a 3D generalist with the instincts of an animator and a storyteller — someone who can take a storyboard and carry it through the entire production process on their own.

You'll own the full arc of a piece: starting from a storyboard, building it into a boardomatic, developing it into a full animatic, then taking it all the way through to final animation, lighting and render setups, editing, and motion graphics. This is a role for someone who thinks in terms of pacing, composition, and narrative — not just technical execution — and who can make strong creative calls without needing every beat directed.

This is project\-based contract work for an experienced generalist who can own the pipeline from brief to delivery with minimal direction.

**What We Need**

A 3D generalist / animator who can:

* Take a storyboard and develop it into a boardomatic, then a full animatic
* Carry a piece through to final animation with strong sense of timing, staging, and storytelling
* Handle lighting and render setups end\-to\-end
* Finish the piece through editing and motion graphics
* Make strong visual and narrative decisions independently (composition, pacing, storytelling, design)
* Communicate proactively, flag issues early, and meet deadlines consistently

**Requirements**

* Several years of professional 3D and animation experience (studio, agency, or freelance)
* **Expert\-level Blender workflow** — all 3D work is done in Blender
* **Senior\-level proficiency across the Adobe suite** (After Effects, Premiere Pro) for editing and motion graphics
* Demonstrated storytelling and animation instincts — pacing, staging, composition
* Proven track record delivering finished, narrative\-driven pieces end\-to\-end and independently
* **A portfolio that includes actual videos** — finished, moving work. Stills alone will not be considered for this role. Please note your specific role on each piece.

**Bonus Skills**

* Storyboarding or boardomatic/previs experience
* Sound and music editing to picture
* Real\-time engine experience (Unity)

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* A brief intro explaining why you're a great fit, with emphasis on your storytelling and animation strengths
* Your portfolio **including actual video work**, with your role on each piece clearly noted
* Any relevant motion graphics, previs, or automation experience

**Contract Details**

This is an independent contractor position, not full\-time employment. Work is project\-based with strong potential for ongoing collaboration. We have a steady pipeline of projects and are looking for long\-term relationships with reliable talent. You'll work within our pipeline by remoting into our machines, so no need to provide your own software or hardware.

Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Walk us through a project you took from storyboard all the way to final delivery. How did you handle the progression from boardomatic to animatic to final animation?
* How do you approach storytelling and pacing in your animation work? What makes a piece land for you beyond technical polish?
* Describe your proficiency with Blender for animation, lighting, and rendering, and with the Adobe suite (After Effects, Premiere Pro) for editing and motion graphics.
* Are you comfortable working remotely by connecting to a client's machine and working within an established pipeline and file structure? Please describe any similar remote workflow experience you've had.
* This position offers a compensation range of XX–XX–

$15–$25 per hour, as listed in the job posting. Can you confirm that this range is acceptable to you?

Work Location: Remote

At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1\.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3\.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.**Job Title:**


Information Graphics Editor \- Client Services, Strategic Capital**Company:**


Prologis

**A day in****the life**


At Prologis, we sit at the intersection of global trade, logistics, supply chains, e\-commerce, energy and sustainability. Through our global operating platform, customer relationships and industry\-leading research organization, we have a unique perspective on the forces shaping the global economy.

  

Strategic Capital, our private capital business with $102 billion in assets under management across 17 countries and 11 private funds, depends on clear, accurate and compelling communication to help investors understand those trends.

  

We are looking for an Information Graphics Editor to help define how those stories are told.


Understanding that communication with data is different from other types of graphic design, this role is fully dedicated to information design. Your primary focus will be creating charts, maps, tables and information graphics that transform complex ideas into visual explanations that are clear, insightful and trustworthy.

  

You will work closely with subject matter experts to help explain topics ranging from global trade and supply chains to sustainability, energy, capital markets and logistics real estate. Your role is not simply to visualize data, it is to help people understand it.

  

This role will partner with our Lead Designer to ensure quantitative and qualitative storytelling work together seamlessly across presentations, reports, email and investor communications.


Unlike many corporate design roles, you will have the opportunity to focus deeply on the craft of information design while helping establish the standards, systems and workflows that make our graphics more consistent, more scalable and easier to produce.

  

We are equally interested in preserving craftsmanship and exploring innovation. This role will help shape where emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can improve efficiency and where thoughtful human judgment and accuracy remains essential.

 **Key responsibilities****include:**

* Design and produce charts, graphs, tables, maps and information graphics across Strategic Capital presentations, reports and investor communications
* Translate complex quantitative information into clear, accurate and engaging visual narratives
* Evolve the visual language of Strategic Capital's information graphics so every visualization complements the Prologis brand while remaining clear, consistent and immediately understandable
* Partner with subject matter experts to identify the most effective way to communicate complex ideas visually
* Develop reusable chart libraries, templates and visualization standards that improve consistency, scalability and production efficiency
* Create graphics for investor presentations, quarterly reports, fundraising materials, market reports and thought leadership content
* Explore emerging visualization tools, automation and AI workflows that improve quality, efficiency and scalability while maintaining analytical integrity
* Stay current on developments in information design, visual journalism and data visualization, bringing new ideas and best practices to the team
**Building blocks for success**

**Required:**

* 5\+ years of experience in information graphics, information design, data visualization, visual journalism or a related discipline
* Deep understanding of data visualization best practices, including chart selection, perceptual accuracy and graphical integrity.
* A portfolio demonstrating excellence in quantitative storytelling through charts, maps, tables and information graphics
* Strong command of typography, color, hierarchy, composition and visual communication principles
* Advanced proficiency in tools such as Excel, Datawrapper, Tableau, Illustrator, Figma or D3\-based tools
* Working proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to integrate visualizations into executive presentations
* Experience with one or more visualization platforms such as Datawrapper, Tableau, Power BI, D3, Python or similar tools
* Strong understanding of information hierarchy, perception and analytical communication
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Curiosity, sound judgment and a collaborative approach to problem solving
**Preferred:**

* Experience in data journalism, economic research, consulting or financial communications
* Experience creating maps and spatial visualizations, including familiarity with ESRI or similar geospatial tools
* Familiarity with motion graphics, Adobe After Effects or Adobe Premiere Pro
* Experience building interactive graphics or web experiences using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including visualization frameworks such as Svelte and D3\.js.
* Familiarity with UX design principles
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS
* Demonstrated willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.
 **Location**


Hybrid. Two to three days in our New York office each week, with the remaining days remote if preferred.

**Hiring Salary Range:** $74,400\-93,000\. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

**People First**


Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. **Individuals take the initiative here.**


When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. **Employees advance their careers here.**


As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. **People come first here.**


All full\-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle\-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time.


All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.**Employment Type:**


Full time**Location:**


New York, New York**Additional Locations:**

**Who is Blueprint?**



We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States. Unified by a shared passion for solving complicated problems, our people are our greatest asset. We use technology as a tool to bridge the gap between strategy and execution, powered by the knowledge, skills, and the expertise of our teams, who all have unique perspectives and years of experience across multiple industries. We're bold, smart, agile, and fun.


**What does Blueprint do?**



Blueprint helps organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting\-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. We connect strategy, business solutions, products, and services to transform and grow companies.


**Why Blueprint?**



At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. You'll focus on solving unique business problems while gaining hands\-on experience with the world's best technology. We believe in unique perspectives and build teams of people with diverse skillsets and backgrounds. At Blueprint, you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple clients and teams, such as data science and product development, all while learning, growing, and developing new solutions. We guarantee you won't find a better place to work and thrive than at Blueprint.

### **In This Role**



As a Motion Designer, you will create, edit, and enhance high\-quality video and motion graphics assets that support customer\-facing, marketing, social media, and digital experiences. You will transform raw footage, product demonstrations, and creative concepts into compelling visual stories that engage audiences and clearly communicate key messages. This role requires a combination of strong motion design expertise, video editing skills, visual storytelling ability, and production discipline. Success in this position depends on delivering polished creative assets while managing project timelines, file organization, version control, and stakeholder feedback in a fast\-paced production environment.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


### **Motion Design \& Video Creation**


* Create high\-quality motion graphics, animations, video edits, and visual treatments for customer\-facing, marketing, and social media content.
* Translate product narratives, creative concepts, and source materials into engaging motion and video assets.
* Develop polished visual content that supports storytelling, product education, and audience engagement.
* Edit and refine content to improve pacing, clarity, visual appeal, and overall effectiveness.

### **Video Editing \& Post\-Production**


* Edit raw footage, screen captures, demonstrations, animations, and visual assets into finished video content.
* Apply motion effects, transitions, typography, color correction, audio synchronization, and other finishing elements to meet quality standards.
* Prepare deliverables across multiple formats, channels, aspect ratios, and platforms.
* Ensure all final assets are accurate, brand\-compliant, accessible, and ready for stakeholder review or publication.

### **Design Quality \& Brand Execution**


* Apply strong visual design principles across composition, typography, timing, pacing, hierarchy, and storytelling.
* Maintain consistency with established brand standards and creative direction.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer understanding and engagement through thoughtful motion design and editing decisions.
* Balance creative excellence with project timelines, production requirements, and business objectives.

### **Production Management \& Workflow**


* Manage file organization, naming conventions, version control, asset tracking, and delivery processes.
* Maintain production timelines, milestones, schedules, and status updates across multiple projects.
* Track revisions, approvals, stakeholder feedback, and final deliverables.
* Communicate risks, blockers, dependencies, and timeline changes proactively.

### **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Support**


* Partner with design, product, marketing, and business stakeholders to understand project goals and requirements.
* Communicate project status, timelines, deliverables, and challenges effectively.
* Prepare design explorations, revised cuts, and final assets for stakeholder review.
* Contribute creative recommendations that improve storytelling, customer understanding, and overall content performance.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent projects.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Motion Design, Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Film/Video Production, Digital Media, Studio Art/Fine Art, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in motion design, video editing, or digital content production.
* Advanced proficiency with Adobe After Effects and/or Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Experience with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
* Experience using productivity and collaboration tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and AI\-assisted workplace technologies.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating:
	+ Motion graphics
	+ Video editing
	+ Visual storytelling
	+ High\-quality production execution
* Experience creating motion and video content for marketing, social media, customer\-facing, digital, or product\-related initiatives.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ Motion design principles
	+ Typography
	+ Visual hierarchy
	+ Composition
	+ Pacing and timing
	+ Brand consistency
* Experience managing file organization, naming conventions, version control, production schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience creating motion graphics or video content within technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or productivity\-focused environments.
* Knowledge of video accessibility best practices, including:
	+ Captioning
	+ Readability
	+ Color contrast
	+ Clear visual communication
* Experience working in structured production environments with formal review processes, approval workflows, and stakeholder feedback cycles.
* Demonstrated success balancing creative execution with operational and production management responsibilities.

The community team at FIGS supports our incredible healthcare professional ambassadors. This incredible group of people are leaders in their given space, changemakers for healthcare, and incredible advocates for our brand on social and beyond. This position will work closely with social, impact, and other cross functional partners frequently.


What you'll do:


* Work closely with community team to support all ambassador inclusive initiatives both internally and externally
* Support digital and in person event planning for ambassador community
* Help maintain up to date information and details on our awesome humans
* Responsible for supporting our exciting new product launches with sampling and ordering
* Aid in content creation for community specific social media platforms and inboxes
* Support threads for threads charitable giving efforts, communicating with partners and charitable organizations
* Opportunity to assist with digital design and content creation needs


About this person:


* Self\-driven, positive and able to manage multiple projects at once
* Familiarity with digital creator space, specifically: Instagram, Tik Tok, and Youtube
* Interest in influencer marketing and relationship management
* General understanding of the healthcare space, and willingness to learn more
* Self starter, articulate written \& verbal communication skills, social, adaptable
* Understanding of Excel, Shopify, CreatorIQ and other social reporting tools a plus


What you'll bring:


* 2\+ years of experience in social media and influencer marketing
* Experience with reporting on influencer marketing campaigns and related efforts
* Experience communicating clearly and effectively via email, phone and social media
* Proven work ethic and integrity
* Positive attitude
* Desire to excel and grow with FIGS
* Aspiration to create change and make an immediate impact
* Entrepreneurial spirit and egoless nature


**FIGS Compensation and Benefits**


*Pay Range*


* At FIGS, your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. This role's base salary range is between $70,000 and $75,000\. Actual base salary is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


*Additional Compensation and Benefits*


* Equity: All FIGS employees have the opportunity to own shares of FIGS stock through our new\-hire equity program. Additionally, FIGS provides a discount when purchasing FIGS stock voluntarily through our FIGS Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* **Annual bonus: This position is eligible to participate in the FIGS annual bonus program**
* Other compensation and benefits offered include:
* + Comprehensive benefits and perks package focused on your well\-being, including premium medical, dental and vision coverage, and full access to wellness services through Breethe and Classpass. 100% FIGS\-sponsored life insurance and disability insurance
	+ Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution
	+ Generous paid time off \- We have 12 company holidays. For salaried team members, we offer flexible vacation. For our hourly team members, we offer up to 3 weeks of accrued vacation
	+ Meaningful time away for baby bonding, including parental leave, new parent care meals, and a transition back to work for primary caregivers
	+ FIGS sponsored Uber Eats voucher for in\-office weeks
	+ Personalized discount code for 50% off all FIGS products, along with a separate code to share with family and friends to enjoy a 25% discount site\-wide
	+ Access to FIGS Vet, Discounted Pet Daycare, Discounted Pet Insurance, and so much more…
* *Benefits eligibility is determined by hour requirements and length of service*

  


**A little bit about us…**



FIGS, Inc. is a founder\-led, direct\-to\-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. With the largest DTC platform in healthcare apparel, we sell our products to a rapidly growing community of loyal customers. Through these customer relationships, FIGS has built a community and lifestyle around a profession, revolutionizing the large and fragmented healthcare apparel market and becoming the industry's category\-defining healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand.



Our Threads for Threads initiative is integral to our mission to improve the lives of healthcare professionals on a global scale. Founded alongside FIGS in 2013, Threads for Threads donates scrubs to healthcare professionals working in resource\-poor countries around the world.

***FIGS considers all Qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories (e.g., arrests or conviction records), for Employment in accordance with applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.***


***For information about how we process information in connection with your application, view our Employee \& Applicant Privacy Policy linked in the footer below.***

**The Role**
------------



As a member of the Brand Equity \& Activation Team, the Social Media Manager, RYTHM \& RYTHM Beverage will develop and execute the social content strategy and production for our RYTHM and RYTHM Beverage brands, with hands\-on content creation at the center of the role. This is a maker's seat: you'll shoot, edit, and publish the content that builds these brands, from lo\-fi reactive video to polished event capture. You'll work collaboratively with events \& experiences, creative, retail marketing, sales, compliance, brand, and external partners to craft authentic moments of connection for our audience.



We're seeking an innovative, creative social media expert who lives social both inside and outside of work. (Don't be shy, show us that screen time!) You have a deep understanding of the voice, tone, and style that resonate across Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, TikTok, and YouTube and you produce your own content masterfully. You can run a shoot, cut a Reel, and turn a moment into a post the same day.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* **Create content across formats.** Shoot and edit short\-form video and photography (lo\-fi self\-produced and event capture), and produce graphics via Photoshop / Canva, for RYTHM and RYTHM Beverage social channels.
* **Travel to RYTHM and RYTHM Beverage events** to capture and deliver social content in real time, including evenings and weekends.
* Develop and execute a winning social strategy (in concert with the Sr. Social Media Strategist) that drives audience engagement and growth while building the brands.
* Own an ongoing content calendar across all key social channels, in partnership with the broader brand teams.
* Write engaging, channel\-appropriate copy that manifests each brand's voice authentically.
* Continuously monitor performance and translate channel / campaign data into actionable insights; establish social KPIs and produce monthly reports tracking progress.
* Conduct periodic competitive audits and implement new / reactive plans as needed.
* Partner with the Community Manager on community initiatives and the Influencer \& Affiliate Manager on creator content.
* Stay current on platform guidelines and cannabis industry restrictions, with an eye toward successful, compliant workarounds by channel.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 2\+ years in social media management, building social followings on Instagram \& YouTube and ideally TikTok, Reddit, and Facebook.
* **Hands\-on content production is required:** you can shoot and edit lo\-fi photography and short\-form video (Edits, CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent) and build graphics in Photoshop and/or Canva. Be ready to show a reel of self\-produced work.
* You love a fast pace and don't mind frequent pivots \- cannabis is a highly regulated, fluid industry that demands quick thinking, and social media for cannabis is always changing.
* Fluent in social tools \- Sprout Social, Meta Business Manager, or similar.
* You write engaging copy that lands the brand voice in a relevant, authentic, channel\-appropriate way.
* You organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects under strict deadlines with a variety of opinionated stakeholders.
* You eat, sleep, and breathe social — trends, world news, pop culture, fandoms.
* You understand cannabis culture, and you know which brands show up authentically on social and which are trying too hard.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------


* Must pass any and all required background checks
* Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry
* Must possess valid driver's license
* Must be a minimum of 21 years of age
* Must be approved by state badging agency to work in cannabis industry

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.


We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

**Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:**

* **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
* **Free BJ’s Memberships:** Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.\*
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.\*
* **Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits:** Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.\*
* **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan:** Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).\*
* **Employee Stock Purchase Plan:** Accumulate funds through after\-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.\*

* Eligibility requirements vary by position.


Position Summary  

The Copywriter is responsible for developing compelling creative concepts and on brand copy that support business objectives across multiple platforms. Working closely with art directors and project managers, this role requires bringing ideas to life through clear, engaging, and effective messaging.


Key Responsibilities

* Deliver copy and concepts that align to the approved creative brief, brand standards, and project requirements.
* Incorporate feedback to refine ideas, strengthen writing, and deliver work that is effective and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Execute projects and deliverables within established timelines.
* Collaborate with Art Directors to develop creative concepts.
* Engage, communicate and present ideas effectively in meetings providing meaningful input to drive collaboration and decision\-making.


Drive for Results

* Apply problem\-solving skills to achieve goals and overcome challenges
* Leverage insights, data and available information to develop effective creative
* Identify and communicate opportunities to improve creative work, and processes
* Enable on\-time execution while maintaining high quality standards
* Approach every project from a member perspective putting them first in everything we do


Leadership \& Collaboration

* Collaborate effectively with creative team and business partners

* Seek and apply constructive feedback to drive continuous improvement
* Demonstrate flexibility by shifting priorities and responding effectively to change
* Proactively seeks guidance that supports team improvement

* Comfortable discussing strategies and briefs to better understand creative objectives
* Demonstrate strong conceptual thinking across a broad range of tactical channels

For more information, visit our Careers page.

**About EAB**



At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.



At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.



For more information, visit our Careers page.

  


**The Role in Brief:**


***Copywriter (Temporary)***



The Copywriter (Temporary) merges the unique voice of our partner institutions with proven marketing principles to create effective mail and online campaigns. This role requires a basic understanding of direct marketing strategy. The ideal candidate has professional writing experience, a positive attitude, an outstanding work ethic and a passion for serving our student and partner bases.



This position may be based in Richmond, VA or Washington, D.C. **This is a temporary role that will last through December 31, 2026 in our Adult Learner Recruitment division.**

  


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Write and revise original copy for assigned clients
* Learn from feedback to produce copy that is consistently strong and on point
* Contribute to copy and recruitment marketing discussions in client meetings
* Participate in team, client, and process meetings
* Help with special projects, including collateral pieces outside of normal Enrollment Services marketing products
* Work well with others, including Art Directors, Web Designers and account teams
* Support the Copywriting group by providing coverage and taking on overflow work
* Possess the technical flexibility to quickly adapt to changing systems and processes

  


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in related field
* At least 2 years writing experience in a professional setting
* Ability to manage time and meet tight deadlines as well as work late hours/weekends as needed

  


**Ideal Qualifications:**


* Demonstrated experience in a team setting
* Ability to conform writing to prescribed styles
* Ability to accept and learn from constructive criticism
* Strong organizational skills with ability to handle multiple priorities/deadlines
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspirations.


*If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome diversity of background and experience. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.*

  


**Compensation:**



The anticipated starting compensation for this role is $18 \- $20 per hour. Actual compensation varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting compensation range for their role.

At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and are committed to fostering a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard.



To that end, EAB is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we make employment decisions on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

This is a hands\-on, creative leadership role that combines social media strategy, content creation, digital marketing, and brand management. You'll work closely with our Vice President of Sales \& Marketing to shape how thousands of couples and corporate clients discover and experience our brand.

If you're passionate about hospitality, weddings, storytelling, AI\-powered marketing, and creating content that converts, we'd love to meet you.

* Own and execute SEG's social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.

* Develop engaging Reels, Stories, videos, and campaigns that increase brand awareness and generate qualified leads.
* Analyze performance metrics and continually optimize content for engagement and conversions.

* Capture real\-time event content across multiple venues.
* Plan and direct styled photo shoots and creative campaigns.

* Develop multi\-channel marketing campaigns that support sales goals.

Lead the Creative Team

* Provide creative direction while ensuring brand consistency across all venues and platforms.
* Manage content calendars and prioritize venue coverage based on business needs and sales activity.

Build Relationships

* Collaborate with photographers, planners, florists, vendors, and agency partners.
* Identify PR opportunities and community partnerships that strengthen the SEG brand.
* Help expand our reach through strategic advertising and industry relationships.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* 3–5\+ years of marketing, branding, social media, or creative leadership experience.
* Hospitality, wedding, or event industry experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of social media strategy, algorithms, and current trends.
* Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills.
* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, CMS platforms, Microsoft Office, and AI marketing tools.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


**About the Role:**

We are seeking a creative expert to join our Performance Marketing team as Manager, Performance Creative. This role leads creative ideation and concept development that fuels Netflix's global performance marketing operation: from data\-driven ad concepts and creator partnerships to new content categories and channel\-specific creative strategy. The ideal candidate combines creative thinking with performance marketing expertise: someone who can turn audience insights and competitive research into breakthrough concepts, and partner across Brand, Social, and Production to bring them to life at scale.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead creative ideation and concept development, translating performance insights, audience data, and market trends into creative briefs ready for production.
* Collaborate with designers, writers, producers, and media buyers to turn concepts into high\-performing assets, partnering closely with the Creative Producer on production handoff.
* Partner with Growth Strategy to build and execute a forward\-looking creative testing roadmap, with clear hypotheses on hooks, value props, visual styles, messaging, and more.
* Own the creative strategy for net\-new content categories beyond single\-title assets: multi\-title, lifestyle, catalog, and licensed content.
* Build and manage Netflix's creator program for performance marketing: identify, brief, and manage creator agency relationships for scaled, performance\-centric native content across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond.
* Serve as the creative lead on new and emerging channel formats (DSP, CTV, YouTube), defining the creative approach and specs as we enter new placements.
* Establish a reactive pipeline that can jump on trends and insights, and turn assets around rapidly.
* Partner with Brand to conceptualize larger performance marketing moments that sell the full value of Netflix to potential members beyond individual title campaigns.
* Stay ahead of platform trends, creative techniques, and cultural moments, turning them into fresh concepts and rapid\-response creative opportunities.

**Requirements**

* 7\+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, or growth marketing, ideally with entertainment or consumer brand experience.
* A proven track record of creative concepts that directly resulted in measurable CPA reduction or revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of ad performance metrics (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS) and the ability to translate data into clear, actionable creative direction.
* Deep hands\-on experience across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, DSPs, and emerging digital channels.
* Experience managing creator partnerships and influencer programs for performance marketing.
* Resourceful and endlessly curious, with a high comfort level for independently driving complex creative initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
* High tolerance for change and the capacity to accomplish significant work in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment.
* Strong level of ownership, accountability, and ability to manage multiple stakeholders across different projects.
* Respect, understanding, and enthusiasm for Netflix culture.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $220,000\.00 \- $347,000\.00\.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .


Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .


Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.


We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
